## Checklist (must be satisfied before approval)

- [ ] All code changes are on a `task/<description>` branch.
- [ ] `git status` shows no untracked files (everything committed).
- [ ] `pytest --cov` runs locally with **overall ≥ 95 %** and **per‑file ≥ 99 %**.
- [ ] CI workflow passes (lint, tests, coverage enforcement).
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`) updated if needed.
- [ ] No TODOs or `# pragma: no cover` left unintentionally.

*I understand that the maintainer will only merge after confirming these items.*
